Hi Michael,

We signed up via the self-serve flow and requested a dedicated capacity demo. Quick context on our workload so the session can be productive:
- Product: real-time summarization for customer chat logs
- Typical input: ~400 tokens, 95th pct around 1,200 tokens for long sessions
- Traffic: steady baseline ~150 QPS, peak burst to ~400 concurrent requests; daily spiky windows (~15–20 mins)
- Target: P95 latency under ~250ms for 400-token requests; willing to tolerate higher p95 for the long 1,200-token requests but want to discuss fallbacks

Can an engineer join to go over latency tuning and bump/burst handling? Also please include any pre-demo checklist we should fill out.

Thanks,
